adds_to: RNPBENCH_EVALUATE_FIXTURE_RULE_V2 (the six existing fixtures are kept unchanged)
purpose: software regression fixtures for scored AlphaFold 3, Chai-1 and RF2NA outputs; not a scientific selection; no fixture value is a benchmark result

pool_per_engine.source: the released score_v3 stores (AF3: score_v3_released/released_AF3_exec_A.json; CHAI1: score_v3_released_chai/released_CHAI1_all_samples.json, execution A; RF2NA: score_v3_released_rf2na/released_RF2NA_exec_A.json)
pool_per_engine.designated_output_only: AF3: the frozen is_top1 flag of the per-sample score store, joined by structure_checksum (the governing rule of the AF3 reconciliation, 2026-10-08); CHAI1: is_the_selected_output == true; RF2NA: the single designated official output per invocation
eligibility: target in the 59-target five-engine common population
a frozen four-axis geometry row exists for the same engine and structure_checksum
the reference holds exactly one protein chain and one RNA chain (frozen native label map)
target not already used by an existing fixture or by an earlier engine in engines_in_order

selection: smallest protein + RNA construct length; ties by target identifier
if_a_pool_is_empty: report the empty pool and stop for review; no criterion is relaxed
checks_required_per_fixture: status, rounded DockQ, unrounded DockQ, DockQ class, selected mapping, admissible candidates, interfaces, residue correspondence counts, per-interface DockQ terms and contact counts, four-axis geometry values and counts, exclusion
